title: TWO CONTRACTS DONE TOGETHER BOTH SHOW
why: Since the objective lines went to caps, every finished contract says the same headline, CONTRACT DONE, with its own words as the detail. One crate that finished an open contract and a district contract in the same frame said the line twice, and the second refreshed the first in place and wrote its detail over it, so the first contract was never named in the raid. Two lines that each carry a key of their own are now two lines even with the same headline, and each contract says its line under its own key. Lines with no key refresh in place exactly as before.
now: Two contracts that finish on the same box each show their own CONTRACT DONE line.
